floor_enter.title: WELCOME TO FLOOR {floor}
floor_enter.body: You have 5 in-game days to find the stairwell before the ceiling becomes your new hat. No previews. Good luck, meatbag.

floor_enter.title: NEW FLOOR INITIALIZED — FLOOR {floor}
floor_enter.body: The galactic broadcast ratings just ticked up 0.4%. Try not to trip over a draugr in the first five minutes.

safe_room_discovered.title: NEW ACHIEVEMENT! COWARD'S SANCTUARY!
safe_room_discovered.body: You found a Safe Room! Monsters legally cannot follow you inside due to Syndicate Zoning Ordinance 44-B. Browse the vendor and catch your breath.

boss_arena_sealed.title: LOCKDOWN ENGAGED — PRIME TIME BRAWL!
boss_arena_sealed.body: The Iron Gate just slammed shut behind you! Two creatures enter, one crawler gets access to the Treasure Vault.

boss_defeated.title: NEW ACHIEVEMENT! HR COMPLAINT FILED!
boss_defeated.body: You dismantled the Floor Boss! The Treasure Vault seal has been lifted. Collect your totally-not-rigged loot before the floor collapses.

sponsored_loot.title: SPONSORED DROP! DON'T FORGET TO SMILE!
sponsored_loot.body: A wealthy off-world sponsor noticed your flailing and dropped Mythic gear: {item_name}. Mention them in your obituary!

floor_collapse.title: FLOOR COLLAPSE! TIME'S UP, CRAWLER!
floor_collapse.body: Five days elapsed and you're still here. Rewinding you to your Floor-Entry Snapshot. Maybe walk faster next attempt?

player_death.title: NEW ACHIEVEMENT! GRAVITY & SHARP OBJECTS!
player_death.body: You died! Luckily our contract forbids permanent cancellation on this tier. Restoring your Floor-Entry Snapshot...

level_up.title: LEVEL UP — LEVEL {level}!
level_up.body: Slightly harder to squish! Spend your Skill/Attribute bonuses in your Character Menu [Tab / I].

time_warning.title: COLLAPSE WARNING — {days_left} DAYS REMAINING
time_warning.body: Reminder: the stone ceiling is scheduled to meet the stone floor. Find the hidden stairwell.

first_kill.title: NEW ACHIEVEMENT! FIRST BLOOD!
first_kill.body: You successfully applied sharp metal to a hostile resident. Viewership up 12%!
